one_liner: an invoicing app for small bookkeeping firms
one_liner_variants: an invoicing app for small bookkeeping firms
something to help my bookkeeping firm bill clients
an app to send invoices and get paid
persona: Owner of a 3-person bookkeeping firm. Practical, not technical. Wants clients to self-serve where it saves staff time, but keeps things simple otherwise.
persona_variants: Owner of a 3-person bookkeeping firm. Practical, not technical. Wants clients to self-serve where it saves staff time, but keeps things simple otherwise.
Office manager at a small accounting practice. Cautious, cares about getting the paperwork legally right, dislikes anything that adds steps.
Bookkeeping firm owner who is impatient and wants automation everywhere; happy to let the tool decide details that do not affect clients.
extra_context:
Example of an invoice we send today (typed up from the Word template we want to replace):

LEDGERLIGHT BOOKKEEPING LLC
42 Alder Street, Portland, OR — books@ledgerlight.example

INVOICE INV-0231                                Date: 2026-07-01   Due: 2026-07-15
Bill to: Cascade Dental Group (client #C-018), attn. Practice Manager

Description                                   Qty      Rate       Amount
Monthly bookkeeping retainer — July 2026       1     $650.00     $650.00
Quarterly payroll reconciliation               3      $85.00     $255.00

Subtotal                                                         $905.00
Tax (8.0%)                                                        $72.40
Total due (USD)                                                  $977.40
Paid 2026-07-03 — partial payment received (card)                $500.00
Balance due                                                      $477.40

Pay online: https://pay.ledgerlight.example/INV-0231 (card or bank) — a PDF copy is attached to the email.
This retainer invoice is generated and sent automatically on the 1st of each month.
Note: sent invoices are never edited; corrections go out as a credit note (see CN-0042 for INV-0227).
Reminder emails go out automatically at 7 and 14 days past due. No late fees.
truth: The firm bills its own clients (firm bills own clients); it does NOT send invoices on behalf of clients to their customers. It is a single org tool for this one firm. Several people log in (multi user): the owner and staff, with an owner staff split in powers. Clients have their own accounts and log into a portal (portal) where they view act: see their invoices and pay them online. Payment recording is both: clients pay online and staff can also mark invoices paid by hand; money is collected online (collect online) via a card/bank provider. Partial payments are allowed. Tax is a single rate per invoice. One currency (single). Recurring invoices yes: monthly retainers are created and sent automatically, so recurring records are created on a schedule. Overdue invoices get auto reminders. No late fees (none). Estimates yes convert to invoices. Credit notes are used for corrections. No expenses tracking (no). No time tracking (no). Invoices are delivered both as PDF email and a hosted link. Accounting sync with QuickBooks (sync). Detailed invoice statuses. Branding is logo colors. No deposits. Invoice numbering is sequential. A sent invoice is locked; corrections go through a credit note. Notifications by email. Sign in with email password. Basic audit trail. Soft delete (archive). Data import from a spreadsheet once (import spreadsheet). CSV export. Data scale small. Integrations: a few key ones (a few key). Online only. Platform: web. No approval workflow (none). Reporting: a basic dashboard. Customization: branding templates. Retention forever. Ordinary business data. Invite flow: invite by admin. Concurrency: last write wins. Attachments basic. Localization single locale. Any bookkeeper may send an invoice (any bookkeeper).

rules: A client never sees another client's invoice
An invoice cannot be sent twice
A sent invoice's amounts never change; corrections use a credit note
Invoice numbers are sequential with no gaps
Only the firm owner can delete a client
